name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B-Distill
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A distillation of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.107 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-16.

CAVEAT: four ARC rows and nothing else. MMLU on the same table goes the other way (0.838 -> 0.834, which the card correctly calls within noise at SE 0.003), so this is 'equal on MMLU, better on ARC', not a broad capability jump. The name says Qwen3.8 but the base column in the card's table is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, which matches the base_model tag - the delta is the distill target, not a different starting point.
